import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Data
years = [2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023]
gdp_values = [
    3959894794039.21,
    3941398957073.94,
    4355251953410.78,
    4201021706478.62,
    4562207532490.28
]

# Plotting the line chart
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(years, gdp_values, marker='o', linestyle='-', color='blue')
plt.title('Germany Annual GDP (Current US Dollars) 2019-2023')
plt.xlabel('Year')
plt.ylabel('GDP (USD)')
plt.grid(True)
plt.xticks(years)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
